comment: ShellX Link pairing vectors. proof = HMAC-SHA256(key: code, message: 'shellx-link-pair/1' || 0x00 || UTF-8(machine_id) || 0x00 || UTF-8(link_slot) || 0x00 || host_key || client_key), computed with CryptoKit and cross-checked with Python hmac. All binary values are base64url without padding.
